# Settings, Trades and Orders, every page inside the shell's iframe
go to Settings
set Display name to "Jane Q"
click Save in the Profile section
verify "Saved" is displayed
go to Trades
click the refresh icon in Open Trades
click New Trade
set Trade Date to 2 days from today
click x in the Trade Entry dialog
go to Orders
set Quantity in the row where Order ID is A-950 to 5
verify Quantity in that row is 5
